# `File`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.File -- filesystem I/O.

Every path argument is a typed `Ipe.Path.Path`, not a raw `String`: build
one with `Path.fromString` (which rejects `..` traversal escapes and NUL
bytes) before handing it to any function here, so an unvalidated string can
never reach a filesystem syscall.

Every function is effectful (touches the disk) so the return is
always `Task Error _`.

## `readFile`

```ipe
readFile : Path -> Task Error String
```

## `readFileLimit`

```ipe
readFileLimit : Path -> ByteSize -> Task Error String
```

`readFileLimit path cap` — read at most `cap` bytes from the file.
Use `ByteSize.mib 10` or `ByteSize.bytes n` to name the unit at the
call site and prevent silent unit confusion (a bare `Int` of 10 could
mean 10 bytes or 10 MiB). Returns `Err` when the file exceeds the
ceiling; useful to cap memory on untrusted-size inputs. `ByteSize.zero`
is a zero-byte ceiling: only an empty file reads. On Unix anything but
a regular file (a FIFO, a device, a socket, a directory) is refused
without blocking; symbolic links are followed.

## `readFileBytes`

```ipe
readFileBytes : Path -> Task Error (List Int)
```

Read raw bytes as a list of Int.  Use for binary content
(images, encrypted blobs); use `readFile` for UTF-8 text.

## `walk`

```ipe
walk : Path -> Task Error (List Path)
```

`walk root` -- recursively walk `root`, returning the absolute path of
every regular file reachable from it in lexicographic order.  Directories
are not included.  Symlink cycles are detected and skipped; broken symlinks
and unreadable subtrees are silently skipped.  Returns `Err` only if `root`
itself is not a readable directory.

Example:

    case Path.fromString "/my/project" of
        Err e ->
            Task.fail e

        Ok root ->
            File.walk root
                |> Task.andThen
                    (\files ->
                        -- files : List Path
                        Io.println (String.join "\n" (List.map Path.toString files))
                    )

## `walkMatching`

```ipe
walkMatching : Path -> (Path -> Bool) -> Task Error (List Path)
```

`walkMatching root pred` -- like `walk`, but only includes files for
which `pred` returns `True`.  The predicate runs synchronously during the
walk and receives each file's absolute `Path`.

Example — collect only `.ipe` source files:

    walkMatching root (\p -> String.endsWith ".ipe" (Path.toString p))

## `tempFile`

```ipe
tempFile : String -> Task Error String
```

`tempFile prefix` -- create a uniquely-named file in the system
temp dir.  `prefix` is a filename prefix (not a path), so it stays a
`String`.  Returns the absolute path.

## `tempDir`

```ipe
tempDir : String -> Task Error String
```

`tempDir prefix` -- create a uniquely-named directory in the
system temp dir.  `prefix` is a filename prefix (not a path).  Returns
the absolute path.  Caller is responsible for `remove`-ing the directory
when done.
